scientific_integrity: The structural regularity characterization is credited to previous literature. The present claims are the complete integer census and sharp exponential asymptotics. No independent audit is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Originality comparison has considered relevant accessible full texts and mathematical records; a previously published equivalent enumeration under other terminology remains a residual risk.

Finite verification does not replace the exact argument and local central limit theorem.
title: Regular-element census and exponential rarity in finite partition-preserving transformation monoids
